posts.title: Middle East pulls a NATO
posts.description: Turkey, Pakistan, and Saudi Arabia made a defence pact, the basis of which sounds awfully familiar: an attack on one is an attack on all. posts.title: Bahrain - passport as a weapon
posts.description: 69 Bahrainis had their citizenship revoked because their government decided they were traitors. The youngest is a few months old. Their sin? They glorified and sympathized with Iran's enemy actions. What sounds horryfing is in fact - at least in some of the cases - sharing footage online of Iranian drones and missiles, and the damage they caused. Is that really a glorification of enemy aggression?
